answer_1.quote: We investigate the performance of supervised fine-tuning of the whole framework on abstractive summarization. We use XSum , SAMSum , and DialogSum for evaluation, and report ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L . We finetune each model on the training data of each task separately and select the checkpoints with highest ROUGE-L score on the individual validation set.
